Extract from the Morning Translation of July 30, 1931.
SHANGHAI
No. S. I. D. 2588.
17 - 7 - 31

INDIANS ANNAMITE AND KOREAN APPEAL REGARDING JAPANESE
INTRIGUE

The China Times and other local newspapers
publish the following report :-
The Korean, Annamite and Indian revolutionists
in Shanghai yesterday issued the following manifesto
expressing sympathy for the suffering Chinese residents
in Korea:-
"To the Chinese people,
While the oppressed races of Asia are
endeavouring to establish unity, a great massacre of
Chinese residing in Korea suddenly breaks out by Koreans.
This calamity is really unprecedented in history and
the world is staggered at its proportions. The Korean
people although ignorant, will not kill Chinese people
from whose country the wave of revolution emanates
and thus impede their own emancipation. The instigator,
under whose oppression such atrocities have been
committed, cannot deny this. The only saviour to
whom our weak and oppressed nations are looking is
China. Fearing the realization of such a union, the
imperialists, pursuing their unjust and barbarous policy,
have created this disaster in order that they may further
their mad aim to invade Manchuria and Mongolia and
obstruct the unification of the oppressed races. Should
the Chinese Authorities refuse to take strong actions to
settle the incident, the French will also instigate the
Annamites and the British will force the Indians to massacre
one another.
"In pledging our faith to the revolutionary
spirit of the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen to secure the
unification of the oppressed races, our colleagues, in
addition to sending telegrams to our peoples disclosing
the Japanese intrigue, hereby request every one to
remain firm against our common foes.
Pak Huk In ( ), Korean Independent Party
Leh Tsoeng Shung ( ), Annamite Kuomintang.
+ Dz Ya Sing ( ), Indian Youth League".

S4,
Inquire please re
co-operation with S2.
〔签名〕

1931 年 7 月 30 日《晨译》摘录。
上海
S. I. D. 2588 号。
1931 年 7 月 17 日

印度人、安南人（越南人）和朝鲜人就日本阴谋发出的呼吁

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸刊登如下报道：
在沪的朝鲜、安南（越南）和印度革命者昨日发布以下宣言，对居住在朝鲜的受苦中国居民表示同情：
“致中国人民：
当亚洲被压迫民族正努力建立团结之时，朝鲜人突然对在朝华人发动大屠杀。此灾难实为史无前例，其规模令世界震惊。朝鲜人民虽然无知，但不会杀害作为革命浪潮发源地的中国人民，从而阻碍他们自身的解放。在此压迫下犯下如此暴行的煽动者，无法否认这一点。我们弱小和被压迫的民族所仰望的唯一救星是中国。帝国主义列强担心这种团结的实现，推行其不义和野蛮的政策，制造了这场灾难，以便进一步推进其入侵满洲和蒙古的疯狂目标，并阻碍被压迫民族的统一。如果中国当局拒绝采取有力行动解决此事，法国人也将煽动安南人（越南人），英国人将迫使印度人互相屠杀。
“为了秉承已故孙中山博士的革命精神以确保被压迫民族的统一，我们的同志除了向我国人民发送电报揭露日本阴谋外，特此请求每个人对我们共同的敌人保持坚定立场。
朴赫仁（Pak Huk In）（音译），朝鲜独立党
黎仲松（Leh Tsoeng Shung）（音译），安南国民党
+ 迪亚辛（Dz Ya Sing）（音译），印度青年联盟”。

S4，
请查询与 S2 的合作事宜。
〔签名〕
